query: SELECT seq FROM channel_messages c WHERE channel_id = $1 AND seq > $2 AND (($3 AND to_kind IN ('lead', 'team')) OR (NOT $3 AND ((to_kind = 'member' AND to_conversation = $4) OR to_kind IN ('members', 'team')))) AND NOT (c.type = 'person_message' AND c.body->>'member' = '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency i WHERE i.team_copy_channel = c.channel_id AND i.team_copy_seq = c.seq AND i.execution_status IN ('queued', 'delivered'))) ORDER BY seq LIMIT $5
